## Personality

Fred Wright is described as a nice and jolly individual who is considered a model young man with a fine farm. However, he has also been characterized as cantankerous.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P14](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0014), [v3 ch.Evening P15](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000)_

## History

Fred Wright gathered with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Oliver at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in shared dismay after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) accidentally painted the town hall bright blue. He later shared an intimate moment with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), who subsequently announced their engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Eventually, Fred married [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in a ceremony at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), and the couple later welcomed a newborn baby boy.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), +10 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred and Diana's relationship grew romantic when they became engaged after sharing an intimate moment discovered by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). They later married in a wedding ceremony held at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Following their marriage, the couple started a family and had a newborn baby boy.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), +17 more_

- Romantically involved with — engaged to be married  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P18](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0018), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030), +3 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a civic connection as fellow officers and members of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They participate together in local community endeavors and social gatherings, such as meeting at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to react to the accidental bright blue painting of the town hall.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), +7 more_
